method: Two public QA-SRL Gold development CSVs joined to official sentences by qasrl_id, zero-based half-open token ranges and ~!~ span lists; analyzed in connected GitHub read-only source; stdlib Python audit independently implemented and locally fixture-tested.
integrity: No text or worker identifiers redistributed. Three dev-row mismatches appear to stem from accented characters rendered as '?' in answer strings while original source token sequences preserve accented letters; source is not rewritten.
scoring_contract: QA-SRL gold question + source-indexed multiple answer spans; never map syntactic QA to actor/patient by rule; refuse single-name full-correct scoring for multiple answer spans; abstain/quarantine rows with reference text disagreement; use official QA-SRL evaluation for paper-level metrics
test_units: 10/10 local stdlib tests with fictional fixtures; full corpus was audited by separate in-connector JavaScript parser, not re-executed through newly committed Python CLI
test_split_contamination_disclosure: During initial discovery, Brain-X opened official test CSVs and saw high-level aggregate metadata plus a few example answer spans before enforcing dev-only gate. No test model predictions run. Official test split must NOT be described as pristine/unseen by this workstream; preserve separate untouched confirmatory source.
permissions: Public GitHub gold data read for internal metadata audit; rights of underlying Wikipedia/WikiNews original text require independent clearance, not assumed MIT from repository code.
ownership: Independent Brain-X data integrity and scoring falsification; Nova owns QA-SRL model pipeline; Mira authentic source adjudication; Comput shortcut evaluation.
